result.instructions: Tools for Shiftbrook, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on shift at our Leeds site on Saturday?"; "List the leave requests waiting for approval this week."; "Show the approved hours for last month and who has the most.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shiftbrook data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shiftbrook_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shiftbrook_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shiftbrook_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shiftbrook_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shiftbrook_check_key
tools.title: Check API key
tools.description: Check that the API key is valid. Returns the organisation name. Shiftbrook GET /api/v1/auth/test.

tools.name: shiftbrook_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people in the organisation, with open invites. Use status to filter. Shiftbrook GET /api/v1/people.

status.description: Filter by status, as the Shiftbrook API defines it.

tools.name: shiftbrook_get_person
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Get one person by id. Shiftbrook GET /api/v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: shiftbrook_create_person
tools.title: Add a person
tools.description: Add a person to the organisation. Shiftbrook sends that person an invite email. The invite token is not returned. Shiftbrook POST /api/v1/people.

role.description: Role, as the Shiftbrook API defines it.

tools.name: shiftbrook_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the organisation's locations (sites). Shiftbrook GET /api/v1/locations.

tools.name: shiftbrook_get_location
tools.title: Get a location
tools.description: Get one location by id. Shiftbrook GET /api/v1/locations/{id}.

tools.name: shiftbrook_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List shifts in the rota, optionally between two dates. Draft shifts are not published. Shiftbrook GET /api/v1/shifts.

status.description: Filter by status, as the Shiftbrook API defines it.

tools.name: shiftbrook_get_shift

tools.name: shiftbrook_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests. Use status to see only pending or approved requests. Shiftbrook GET /api/v1/leave-requests.

status.description: Filter by status, as the Shiftbrook API defines it.

tools.name: shiftbrook_get_leave_request

tools.name: shiftbrook_approve_leave_request
